author: Scientific specialist /root/cycle_scientific
question: Can dependency-backed selection run the existing required C# verification owners for bounded changes while rejecting false omissions, preserving broad fallback and keeping unconditional integrity gates?
beneficiary: HUB maintainer and production-continuity CI; not a new player-facing feature or production Unity acceptance

brain_contributions.SCI-013: Competing explanations: fewer commands may be justified dependency exclusion or a false omission; challenge both.
brain_contributions.SCI-014: Operationalize coverage as preserved actual command/wrapper obligations, not job count or elapsed time.
brain_contributions.SCI-076: Use dependency inspection, exact command traces and omission mutants for routing correctness; do not infer human productivity.
brain_contributions.SCI-077: Do not count nested wrapper tests twice or attribute historic timeout causes to current routing.

baseline_observations: north-star-csharp currently runs all retained C# steps whenever its coarse scope is true.
ProjectReference chains are actual dependencies: Intake→Loadout→Forge/Domain and AuthoredScene→Narrative; changes must propagate transitively.

The preparation wrapper already executes sampling→conditions, where conditions executes memory and field-presentation→field. Running those covered wrappers again is duplicate verification, not added coverage.
The shared realtime-integration-lab package/lock supplies the browser instrument to multiple consumers; its changes must not be treated as chat-only inside C# selection.
Existing job timeout, pinned SDK/browser setup, artifact diagnostics and unconditional integrity gates remain controls.

predeclared_acceptance.criterion: Declare a finite suite/coverage vocabulary bound to exact existing commands and real source/project/tool/evidence dependencies.
Every existing executable north-star-csharp verification step remains reachable in full/manual/unknown/broad mode; no rule, test, fixture, timeout, expectation or security gate is weakened.
A change to a known leaf selects every direct/transitive consumer required by inspected ProjectReference and non-C# wrapper/browser/source dependencies. Mixed paths union obligations.
Unknown executable/shared paths, selector/workflow contracts, absent/invalid dependency data and unsupported cases select all relevant suites or refuse clearly; no silent empty success.
Known documentary/inventory-only paths preserve unconditional integrity while avoiding unrelated runtime work under the existing contract.

Nested wrapper coverage is represented once: the preparation wrapper covers sampling, conditions, memory, presentation and base field obligations. Duplicate outer selection must not rerun covered child wrappers.
Actual CLI selection and at least one genuine selected existing consumer command execute, with exact input hashes/versions/commands/exit statuses. Dry-run plans alone are not executable acceptance.
Actual Git diff testing includes additions/deletions/renames and an unchanged/empty comparison retains declared broad behavior.
Integration preserves SDK/browser dependencies and diagnostic collection for selected failing suites; skipped unrelated suites are reported as unexecuted, not passed.

required_negative_controls.defect: Remove a required consumer for a shared Domain change.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Independent expected-coverage control fails; false omission cannot pass by sharing the same selector table as its oracle.

required_negative_controls.defect: Omit an actual transitive ProjectReference consumer such as field from Loadout or authored scene from Narrative.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Dependency/coverage validation or independently stated sentinel expectation rejects it.

required_negative_controls.defect: Treat browser package-lock change as unrelated to C# browser consumers.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Broad/shared dependency control selects those consumers or rejects the plan.

required_negative_controls.defect: Claim sampling/conditions/memory coverage without executing preparation wrapper or required child commands.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Coverage validation rejects fabricated covered sets or binds supported declared wrappers to inspected executable command contract.

required_negative_controls.defect: Unknown path, malformed path or unsupported dependency syntax manufactures zero selected suites.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Conservative fallback/refusal; never silent empty success.

required_negative_controls.defect: Select both a covering wrapper and all its covered children as independent top-level executions.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Plan normalization keeps each obligation once or rejects duplicate plan.

required_negative_controls.defect: Selector returns exit0 after a required actual command failed.
required_negative_controls.required_detection: Actual runner/CI integration preserves nonzero failure; retain logs.

outcome_reporting.unit: One routing decision/change set and its required verification obligations; command counts are not independent studies or effort.
report_separately: Selector and negative controls actually executed
Existing real consumer commands actually executed
Full CI status and publication status
no_claims: No invented runtime savings, cost, productivity or causal explanation of prior CI failures.
No production Unity/Windows/Steam, human assessment, rights clearance or P09 completion claim.
No new consumed legacy capability solely from routing changes.

execution_limits: Retain existing workflow and instrument bounds; exact implementation/execution limits must be disclosed by runner. No bypass of administrative policy.
known_uncertainties: Dependency extraction is bounded by supported actual project/wrapper syntax; unsupported additions require broad fallback rather than assumed independence.
Static inclusion of a source in a hash closure may be conservative and does not prove it is a runtime dependency.
The baseline chat recovery-browser60000ms timeout cause is unknown; current routing is not a causal diagnosis.
